Bill.BriefDescription: Continuing to determine bail for the release of a person arrested and detained for a felony offense on an individualized basis by a judicial officer.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bail for felony offenses; amending 2010 c 254 s2 (uncodified); and adding a new section to chapter 10.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: 2010 c 254 s 2 (uncodified) is amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1))) Bail for the release of a person arrested and detained fora felony offense must be determined on an individualized basis by ajudicial officer. (((2) This section expires August 1, 2011.))
Section 1 of this act is added to chapter10.19 RCW.
